6
Ɛsɛ sɛ wɔyi ayamhyehyeɛ adi kyerɛ wɔn a wɔahwe aseɛ
1 # Mat 18.15; Yak 5.19 Anuanom, sɛ mfomsoɔ bi bɛto obi nso a, mo a moyɛ honhom mufoɔ no, montene deɛ ɔte saa no, honhom a ɛdwoɔ mu, monhwɛ mo ho so yie na wɔansɔ mo nso anhwɛ. 2Monsoa mo ho mo ho nnesoa abia, na saa na mode bɛhyɛ Kristo mmara no ma. 3Na sɛ obi bu ne ho sɛ ɔyɛ obi wɔ berɛ ko ɔnyɛ obiara, ɔdaadaa ne ho. 4#2 Ko 13.5 Na ma obiara nsɔ ɔno ara n’adwuma nhwɛ, ɛno na ɔbɛnya ɔno ara ne ho biribi ahoahoa ne ho, na ɛnyɛ obi ho. 5#Rom 14.12 Na obiara bɛsoa ɔno ara n’adesoa. 6#1 Ko 9.14 Ma deɛ wɔkyerɛkyerɛ no asɛm no, ne deɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛ no no mmɔ mu nkyɛ nnepa nyinaa.
Asetena mu aba
7Monnnaadaa mo ho, Onyankopɔn, wɔnsi no atwetweɛ; ɛfiri sɛ deɛ onipa guo no, ɛno ara na ɔbɛtwa. 8#Rom 8.13 Deɛ ɔgu ma ne honam no, firi honam mu bɛtwa porɔeɛ, na deɛ ɔgu ma honhom no firi honhom mu bɛtwa daa nkwa. 9#2 Te 3.13 Na mommma yɛmmmrɛ papayɛ mu; na sɛ yɛampa aba a, yɛbɛtwa so aba ne berɛ mu. 10#2 Pe 1.7 Enti yɛwɔ berɛ a ɛfata a, momma yɛnnyɛ nnipa nyinaa yie, ɛnkanka wɔn a wɔyɛ gyidie no fiefoɔ.
Awieeɛ
11Monhwɛ atwerɛ akɛseɛ a mede me ara me nsa matwerɛ merebrɛ mo yi. 12#Gal 5.11; Flp 3.18-19 Dodoɔ a wɔpɛ sɛ wɔn anim ba nyam honam mu no, wɔn na Kristo Yesu asɛnnua ho taa a wɔmpɛ sɛ wɔtaa wɔn nti, wɔhyɛ mo sɛ montwa twetia. 13Na wɔn a wɔatwa twetia no mpo nni mmara no so, na mmom wɔpɛ sɛ motwa twetia, na wɔahoahoa wɔn ho mo honam mu. 14#1 Ko 1.31; 2.2 Na me deɛ, ɛmpare me sɛ mɛhoahoa me ho, gye yɛn Awurade Yesu Kristo asɛnnua mu; ɛno so na wɔnam abɔ wiase asɛnnua mu ama me, na wɔabɔ me nso asɛnnua mu ama wiase. 15#Gal 5.6; 1 Ko 7.19 Na twetiatwa nyɛ hwee, na momonotoyɛ nso nyɛ hwee, na mmom abɔdeɛ foforɔ. 16#Dwom 125.5 Na dodoɔ a wɔnam saa kwan yi soɔ no, asomdwoeɛ ne mmɔborɔhunu mmra wɔn ne Israel a ɛyɛ Nyankopɔn dea no so. 17#2 Ko 4.10 Na ɛfiri nnɛ, mommma obiara nnha me; na meso Awurade Yesu akam wɔ me nipadua mu.
Nkradie
18Yɛn Awurade Yesu Kristo adom nka mo honhom, anuanom. Amen.

pageProps.chapterText:
Anuanom, sɛ mfomsoɔ bi bɛto obi nso a, mo a moyɛ honhom mufoɔ no, montene deɛ ɔte saa no, honhom a ɛdwoɔ mu, monhwɛ mo ho so yie na wɔansɔ mo nso anhwɛ. Monsoa mo ho mo ho nnesoa abia, na saa na mode bɛhyɛ Kristo mmara no ma. Na sɛ obi bu ne ho sɛ ɔyɛ obi wɔ berɛ ko ɔnyɛ obiara, ɔdaadaa ne ho. Na ma obiara nsɔ ɔno ara n’adwuma nhwɛ, ɛno na ɔbɛnya ɔno ara ne ho biribi ahoahoa ne ho, na ɛnyɛ obi ho. Na obiara bɛsoa ɔno ara n’adesoa. Ma deɛ wɔkyerɛkyerɛ no asɛm no, ne deɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛ no no mmɔ mu nkyɛ nnepa nyinaa.

Monnnaadaa mo ho, Onyankopɔn, wɔnsi no atwetweɛ; ɛfiri sɛ deɛ onipa guo no, ɛno ara na ɔbɛtwa. Deɛ ɔgu ma ne honam no, firi honam mu bɛtwa porɔeɛ, na deɛ ɔgu ma honhom no firi honhom mu bɛtwa daa nkwa. Na mommma yɛmmmrɛ papayɛ mu; na sɛ yɛampa aba a, yɛbɛtwa so aba ne berɛ mu. Enti yɛwɔ berɛ a ɛfata a, momma yɛnnyɛ nnipa nyinaa yie, ɛnkanka wɔn a wɔyɛ gyidie no fiefoɔ.

Monhwɛ atwerɛ akɛseɛ a mede me ara me nsa matwerɛ merebrɛ mo yi. Dodoɔ a wɔpɛ sɛ wɔn anim ba nyam honam mu no, wɔn na Kristo Yesu asɛnnua ho taa a wɔmpɛ sɛ wɔtaa wɔn nti, wɔhyɛ mo sɛ montwa twetia. Na wɔn a wɔatwa twetia no mpo nni mmara no so, na mmom wɔpɛ sɛ motwa twetia, na wɔahoahoa wɔn ho mo honam mu. Na me deɛ, ɛmpare me sɛ mɛhoahoa me ho, gye yɛn Awurade Yesu Kristo asɛnnua mu; ɛno so na wɔnam abɔ wiase asɛnnua mu ama me, na wɔabɔ me nso asɛnnua mu ama wiase. Na twetiatwa nyɛ hwee, na momonotoyɛ nso nyɛ hwee, na mmom abɔdeɛ foforɔ. Na dodoɔ a wɔnam saa kwan yi soɔ no, asomdwoeɛ ne mmɔborɔhunu mmra wɔn ne Israel a ɛyɛ Nyankopɔn dea no so. Na ɛfiri nnɛ, mommma obiara nnha me; na meso Awurade Yesu akam wɔ me nipadua mu.

Yɛn Awurade Yesu Kristo adom nka mo honhom, anuanom. Amen.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
